[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]An unlabelled task relation is one undirected link, shown [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]everywhere as `🪢 links` with no arrow. A labelled relation is a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]directed statement read from its source. A bare `~~` asks for a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]label. Every writer, reader, and client (bob-cli, bob-plugins, Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture) applies the same pair rules on the unchanged LINKS / [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]LINKED FROM storage, so a plain re-add never erases a label and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pair is never listed twice.[/#D7D7AF]
